data.name: RogueScape
data.detailed_description:
RogueScape is an old-school MMO-inspired survival roguelike where every run starts with a build choice: pick your skills, survive escalating waves, open chests, and turn permanent account progress into stronger future runs.

Choose from combat, gathering, production, and support skills before each run. Swing swords with Attack, fire piercing arrows with Ranged, chain lightning through groups with Magic, orbit shields with Defense, smash enemies with Strength, or lean into survival tools like Woodcutting, Mining, Fishing, Cooking, Smithing, Herblore, Crafting, Agility, and Slayer. Your selected skills level up during the run, unlocking stronger effects and stranger synergies as the pressure builds.

Runs are built around survival, decision-making, and momentum. Enemies are fewer and tougher than a typical swarm game, so kills matter, positioning matters, and each upgrade can change how your build handles the next wave. Last long enough and the Reaper arrives to bring the run to its final reckoning.

Between runs, your account keeps growing. XP earned in a run feeds permanent skill progression, giving that familiar long-term grind a roguelike loop: lose, learn, level, rebuild, and come back stronger.

Features

  • Build around MMO-style skills with combat, gathering, production, and support options.

  • Survive 20-minute runs against escalating enemy waves and mini-boss pressure.

  • Earn XP toward permanent account-wide skill progression.

  • Open chests mid-run to gain skill levels and push your build further.

  • Create powerful synergies between weapons, shields, magic, sustain, gathering buffs, crafted boosts, and defensive tools.

  • Fight fewer, tougher enemies where movement, sustain, and upgrade choices matter.

  • Explore a dark pixel-fantasy world with chunky old-school UI, skill icons, chests, achievements, and satisfying progression.

RogueScape is not affiliated with Jagex or RuneScape.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated graphics card with OpenGL 3.3 / Vulkan support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card or modern integrated graphics with Vulkan support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio
  • Additional Notes: Designed for full controller support and Steam Deck compatibility testing before release.
